achievements.name: A Hundred Questions
achievements.hint: A hundred questions answered in the dungeon. Right or wrong, each one counts.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred questions faced. The dungeon is only getting started.

achievements.name: A Thousand Questions
achievements.hint: A thousand questions answered in the dungeon.
achievements.unlocked_text: A thousand questions faced across your journeys.

achievements.name: Ten Thousand Questions
achievements.hint: Ten thousand questions answered in the dungeon.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten thousand questions. Scholars in Alexandria would nod.

achievements.name: The Endless Exam
achievements.hint: A hundred thousand questions. Yes, really.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred thousand questions. There may be no one alive who has faced more.

achievements.name: On a Roll
achievements.hint: Twenty-five right in a row, from one quiz to the next.
achievements.unlocked_text: Twenty-five right answers without a single slip.

achievements.name: Unbroken
achievements.hint: A hundred right in a row.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred right answers in a row. Not one wrong.

achievements.name: Flawless Mind
achievements.hint: Two hundred and fifty right in a row.
achievements.unlocked_text: Two hundred and fifty in a row. Flawless.

achievements.name: Master of Numbers
achievements.hint: Five hundred math questions answered right.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five hundred math questions, answered right.

achievements.name: World-Walker
achievements.hint: Five hundred geography questions answered right.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five hundred geography questions, answered right.

achievements.name: Keeper of Ages
achievements.hint: Five hundred history questions answered right.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five hundred history questions, answered right.

achievements.name: Naturalist
achievements.hint: Five hundred animal questions answered right.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five hundred animal questions, answered right.

achievements.name: Master of the Hearth
achievements.hint: Five hundred cooking questions answered right.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five hundred cooking questions, answered right.

achievements.name: Natural Philosopher
achievements.hint: Five hundred science questions answered right.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five hundred science questions, answered right.

achievements.name: Lover of Wisdom
achievements.hint: Five hundred philosophy questions answered right.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five hundred philosophy questions, answered right.

achievements.name: Wordsmith
achievements.hint: Five hundred grammar questions answered right.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five hundred grammar questions, answered right.

achievements.name: Counter of Costs
achievements.hint: Five hundred economics questions answered right.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five hundred economics questions, answered right.

achievements.name: Student of the Divine
achievements.hint: Five hundred theology questions answered right.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five hundred theology questions, answered right.

achievements.name: Keeper of Curiosities
achievements.hint: A hundred trivia questions answered right.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred trivia questions, answered right.

achievements.name: Reader of Machines
achievements.hint: A hundred AI questions answered right.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred AI questions, answered right.

achievements.name: Polymath
achievements.hint: Every subject, a hundred right answers each.
achievements.unlocked_text: A true polymath: right answers in every subject the dungeon asks.

achievements.name: Tier Cleared
achievements.hint: Every question of one tier of one subject, in one journey.
achievements.unlocked_text: Every question of a tier, answered in one journey.

achievements.name: The Examined Life
achievements.hint: Socrates said the unexamined life is not worth living. Master a tier of philosophy in one journey.
achievements.unlocked_text: Every philosophy question of a tier, answered in one journey.

achievements.name: Curious Mind
achievements.hint: When a question puzzles you, read its card. A hundred times.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred cards read. Curiosity is the start of wisdom.

achievements.name: Lamp-Lit Study
achievements.hint: A hundred questions answered in Study Mode.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred questions studied by lamplight, far from any dungeon.

achievements.name: A Hundred Foes
achievements.hint: A hundred foes defeated.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred foes lie behind you.

achievements.name: A Thousand Foes
achievements.hint: A thousand foes defeated.
achievements.unlocked_text: A thousand foes. The dungeon has started to talk about you.

achievements.name: Ten Thousand Foes
achievements.hint: Ten thousand foes defeated.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten thousand foes. Monsters tell their young about you.

achievements.name: Heavy Hand
achievements.hint: Ten thousand points of damage dealt.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten thousand points of damage, dealt by your own hand.

achievements.name: Siege Engine
achievements.hint: A hundred thousand points of damage dealt.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred thousand points of damage. Walls have fallen to less.

achievements.name: Earthshaker
achievements.hint: A million points of damage dealt.
achievements.unlocked_text: A million points of damage. The ground remembers you.

achievements.name: World-Breaker
achievements.hint: Ten million points of damage dealt.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten million points of damage. Even giants step aside.

achievements.name: Mighty Blow
achievements.hint: A hundred damage in a single blow.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred damage in one blow.

achievements.name: Thunderclap
achievements.hint: A thousand damage in a single blow.
achievements.unlocked_text: A thousand damage in one blow. Thor would approve.

achievements.name: A Blow for the Ballads
achievements.hint: Five thousand damage in a single blow.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five thousand damage in one blow. The bards are already writing.

achievements.name: A Chain of Ten
achievements.hint: Ten right answers in a single attack.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten right answers in one attack: a chain of ten.

achievements.name: Chain-Master
achievements.hint: A hundred attacks with a chain of ten or more.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred chains of ten. Your sums are a weapon.

achievements.name: Bare Knuckles
achievements.hint: Win a fight with empty hands.
achievements.unlocked_text: A foe defeated with nothing in your hands.

achievements.name: Steady Aim
achievements.hint: A hundred foes, defeated from afar.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred foes defeated from a distance.

achievements.name: A Hundred in One Journey
achievements.hint: A hundred foes in a single journey.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred foes in one journey.

achievements.name: A Silver Edge
achievements.hint: In the old wolf-man films, only one metal ever worked.
achievements.unlocked_text: A shapeshifter cut down with silver worked into your blade.

achievements.name: Holy Water
achievements.hint: Every vampire hunter in the old stories carried a little blessed water.
achievements.unlocked_text: One of the unholy, finished by a flask of holy water.

achievements.name: Below the Cellar
achievements.hint: Ten floors down.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten floors down. The cellar is far above you now.

achievements.name: The Deep Roads
achievements.hint: Twenty-five floors down.
achievements.unlocked_text: Twenty-five floors down the deep roads.

achievements.name: Halfway to the Stone
achievements.hint: Halfway down.
achievements.unlocked_text: Halfway to the Stone.

achievements.name: Where Light Forgets
achievements.hint: Seventy-five floors down.
achievements.unlocked_text: Seventy-five floors down, where light forgets.

achievements.name: The Bottom of the World
achievements.hint: All the way down.
achievements.unlocked_text: The bottom of the world. Few have stood here.

achievements.name: Cartographer
achievements.hint: Ten floors, every corner seen.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten floors mapped to the last corner.

achievements.name: Trapfoot
achievements.hint: Fifty traps, found the hard way.
achievements.unlocked_text: Fifty traps found, every one of them with your feet.

achievements.name: That Was Not a Stair
achievements.hint: Mimics are famous for chests. Not only chests.
achievements.unlocked_text: A staircase with teeth. You will never trust stairs again.

achievements.name: The Labyrinth's End
achievements.hint: The bull-headed prisoner of Crete's labyrinth.
achievements.unlocked_text: Asterion is defeated. The labyrinth is quiet.

achievements.name: Stone Cold
achievements.hint: One look from her turned heroes to stone.
achievements.unlocked_text: Medusa is defeated, and you are not a statue.

achievements.name: The Hoard Is Yours
achievements.hint: A dwarf who became a dragon to guard his gold.
achievements.unlocked_text: Fafnir is defeated. The hoard is yours.

achievements.name: Ragnarok Can Wait
achievements.hint: The wolf the gods could not hold.
achievements.unlocked_text: Fenrir is defeated. Ragnarok can wait.

achievements.name: The Destroyer Destroyed
achievements.hint: The angel of the bottomless pit.
achievements.unlocked_text: Abaddon is defeated. The pit is closed.

achievements.name: The Seven Seals
achievements.hint: Seven seals, from the last book of the Bible.
achievements.unlocked_text: All seven seals broken in one journey.

achievements.name: The Story's Way
achievements.hint: Win the way the heroes of the old stories won.
achievements.unlocked_text: A great foe beaten the way the old story says it was beaten.

achievements.name: Wanderer-Slayer
achievements.hint: Some great foes roam wherever they please.
achievements.unlocked_text: A legendary wanderer, defeated.

achievements.name: Arachne
achievements.hint: Defeat the weaver who challenged a goddess.
achievements.unlocked_text: Arachne is defeated.

achievements.name: Lamia
achievements.hint: Defeat the queen who became a serpent.
achievements.unlocked_text: Lamia is defeated.

achievements.name: Talos
achievements.hint: Defeat the bronze giant who guarded Crete.
achievements.unlocked_text: Talos is defeated.

achievements.name: Echidna
achievements.hint: Defeat the mother of monsters.
achievements.unlocked_text: Echidna is defeated.

achievements.name: The Erlking
achievements.hint: Defeat the king who rides through the forest at night.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Erlking is defeated.

achievements.name: Camazotz
achievements.hint: Defeat the death bat of the Maya.
achievements.unlocked_text: Camazotz is defeated.

achievements.name: Cacus
achievements.hint: Defeat the fire-breathing thief who stole from Hercules.
achievements.unlocked_text: Cacus is defeated.

achievements.name: The Sphinx
achievements.hint: Defeat the one who asks riddles at the gate.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Sphinx is defeated.

achievements.name: Rangda
achievements.hint: Defeat the witch-queen of Bali.
achievements.unlocked_text: Rangda is defeated.

achievements.name: The Nemean Lion
achievements.hint: Defeat the lion no blade could cut.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Nemean Lion is defeated.

achievements.name: Baba Yaga
achievements.hint: Defeat the witch whose hut walks on chicken legs.
achievements.unlocked_text: Baba Yaga is defeated.

achievements.name: Jormungandr
achievements.hint: Defeat the serpent who will one day circle the world.
achievements.unlocked_text: Jormungandr is defeated.

achievements.name: Set's Jackal
achievements.hint: Defeat the jackal of the god of chaos.
achievements.unlocked_text: Set's Jackal is defeated.

achievements.name: The Green Knight
achievements.hint: Defeat the knight who can lose his head and pick it up again.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Green Knight is defeated.

achievements.name: Charybdis
achievements.hint: Defeat the whirlpool that swallowed ships.
achievements.unlocked_text: Charybdis is defeated.

achievements.name: Ravana's Arm
achievements.hint: Defeat what is left of the ten-headed king of Lanka.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ravana's Arm is defeated.

achievements.name: The Wendigo
achievements.hint: Defeat the hunger that walks in winter.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Wendigo is defeated.

achievements.name: The Wild Hunt
achievements.hint: Defeat the captain of the riders in the storm.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Wild Hunt is defeated.

achievements.name: Anansi
achievements.hint: Defeat the spider who owns all the stories.
achievements.unlocked_text: Anansi is defeated.

achievements.name: Nidhoggr
achievements.hint: Defeat the dragon that gnaws the roots of the World Tree.
achievements.unlocked_text: Nidhoggr is defeated.

achievements.name: The First Labour
achievements.hint: In the first of his twelve labours, the hero found that his arrows only bounced off.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Nemean Lion, beaten with your bare hands, as Hercules beat it.

achievements.name: The Bronze Heel
achievements.hint: In one telling, an archer's arrow found the one vein of the bronze giant.
achievements.unlocked_text: Talos, brought down from a distance. The ichor ran out of his heel.

achievements.name: In the Polished Shield
achievements.hint: One hero beat her without ever once meeting her eyes.
achievements.unlocked_text: Medusa is defeated, and you saw her only in the bright face of your shield.

achievements.name: Deaf to Riddles
achievements.hint: Odysseus's sailors stopped their ears against a voice that drew men to their ruin.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Sphinx is defeated. She whispered her riddle, and you never heard a word of it.

achievements.name: The Bonnacon
achievements.hint: Defeat the bull of the old bestiaries whose only weapon is what it leaves behind.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Bonnacon is defeated. Mind where you step.

achievements.name: The Calydonian Boar
achievements.hint: Defeat the boar a forgotten goddess sent to ravage a kingdom.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Calydonian Boar is defeated. Calydon's vines can grow again.

achievements.name: The Undying Sisters
achievements.hint: Medusa had two sisters, and the myths swore that neither of them could die.
achievements.unlocked_text: Stheno and Euryale, both defeated in one journey. The myths were wrong about one thing.

achievements.name: The Iron Patriarch
achievements.hint: Defeat the old king who outlived every one of his heirs.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Iron Patriarch is defeated. His audience is over.

achievements.name: The Whispering Crone
achievements.hint: Defeat the fortune-teller who was buried for telling the truth too plainly.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Whispering Crone is defeated. The graves are quiet again.

achievements.name: The Blood Archon
achievements.hint: Defeat the fiend who keeps his ledger in blood.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Blood Archon is defeated. Every debt in his ledger is cancelled.

achievements.name: The Stone Comes Home
achievements.hint: Your village is waiting for the Stone.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Philosopher's Stone is home. Amber will see another spring.

achievements.name: The Lake of Fire
achievements.hint: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.
achievements.unlocked_text: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire, and you were there.

achievements.name: Checkmate
achievements.hint: A knight once played chess with Death to win more time.
achievements.unlocked_text: You played chess with Death, and won.

achievements.name: Great Scott!
achievements.hint: Marty McFly never could stand being called one thing.
achievements.unlocked_text: Nobody calls you chicken.

achievements.name: Weighed and Found Worthy
achievements.hint: Mene, mene, tekel: be weighed, and not found wanting.
achievements.unlocked_text: Weighed on Michael's scales, and found worthy.

achievements.name: The First Fall
achievements.hint: Everyone falls once.
achievements.unlocked_text: You fell. Then you came back. That is the whole secret.

achievements.name: Back Again
achievements.hint: Ten falls, ten returns.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten falls, and ten returns.

achievements.name: Unbowed
achievements.hint: Fifty falls, and still you come back.
achievements.unlocked_text: Fifty falls. Still unbowed.

achievements.name: Death Is a Teacher
achievements.hint: A hundred falls. By now you know the dungeon better than it knows you.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred falls. Death has taught you well.

achievements.name: Forgot to Eat
achievements.hint: Heroes need breakfast too.
achievements.unlocked_text: Starved. Next time, pack a sandwich.

achievements.name: A Very Short Story
achievements.hint: Not every legend is a long one.
achievements.unlocked_text: A legend that ended on the first floor.

achievements.name: Udderly Defeated
achievements.hint: Lose to something that does not exist.
achievements.unlocked_text: Defeated on a farm that does not exist.

achievements.name: The Scythe
achievements.hint: The pale rider never tires.
achievements.unlocked_text: Caught by Death himself.

achievements.name: Field Notes
achievements.hint: Study one family of monsters closely.
achievements.unlocked_text: Your field notes on one family run deep.

achievements.name: Bane
achievements.hint: Know one family of monsters better than it knows itself.
achievements.unlocked_text: You are the bane of a whole family of monsters.

achievements.name: Loremaster
achievements.hint: Five families, mastered.
achievements.unlocked_text: Loremaster: the bane of five families of monsters.

achievements.name: A Circle Closed
achievements.hint: Monster lore runs in circles. Close one.
achievements.unlocked_text: A circle of monster lore, closed.

achievements.name: Old Remedies
achievements.hint: A polished shield, a little beeswax, a scrap of cold iron: the old stories knew what to bring.
achievements.unlocked_text: A gaze turned, a voice unheard and a glamour broken: every old remedy, used.

achievements.name: Bestiary
achievements.hint: Fifty kinds of monster, named and known.
achievements.unlocked_text: Fifty kinds of monster in your bestiary.

achievements.name: The Great Bestiary
achievements.hint: Two hundred and fifty kinds, named and known.
achievements.unlocked_text: Two hundred and fifty kinds of monster, known by name.

achievements.name: Well-Read
achievements.hint: A hundred topics, read in the Lore Codex.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred topics read.

achievements.name: Strange Talents
achievements.hint: Odd habits make odd talents. Ten of them.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten strange talents earned.

achievements.name: Stranger Talents
achievements.hint: Forty odd talents.
achievements.unlocked_text: Forty strange talents. Your friends are worried.

achievements.name: Strangest of All
achievements.hint: A hundred odd talents. Who even are you?
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred strange talents. Nobody else is quite like you.

achievements.name: Appraiser
achievements.hint: A hundred things, known for what they are.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred things identified.

achievements.name: Sage of Things
achievements.hint: A thousand things, known for what they are.
achievements.unlocked_text: A thousand things identified. Nothing fools you now.

achievements.name: Nothing Wasted
achievements.hint: A hundred fallen foes, harvested for the pot.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred harvests. Nothing goes to waste.

achievements.name: Camp Cook
achievements.hint: A hundred meals cooked.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred meals cooked over dungeon fires.

achievements.name: The Cookbook
achievements.hint: Fifty different recipes, cooked at least once.
achievements.unlocked_text: Fifty recipes in your cookbook.

achievements.name: A Feast for Heroes
achievements.hint: In the old sagas, a great deed ended at a long table.
achievements.unlocked_text: A legendary feast, cooked and eaten. The hall goes quiet as you sit down.

achievements.name: The Long Table
achievements.hint: Twelve different legendary feasts, each cooked at least once.
achievements.unlocked_text: Twelve legendary feasts. Valhalla's cooks would ask for your recipes.

achievements.name: Five Courses
achievements.hint: Something hearty, something filling, something arcane, something that teaches and something strange, in one journey.
achievements.unlocked_text: A dish from every part of the kitchen in one journey. A balanced diet, dungeon style.

achievements.name: Stone Soup
achievements.hint: In the old folk tale, a soup began with a stone and ended with everyone's share.
achievements.unlocked_text: A dish of five ingredients. Nobody even had to bring a stone.

achievements.name: Worth the Wait
achievements.hint: Some things are best saved for later. Much later.
achievements.unlocked_text: A dish made with a part you carried thirty floors down. It was worth the wait.

achievements.name: Made to Order
achievements.hint: Tell a smith what you need, and come back for it.
achievements.unlocked_text: A smith's special order, made to your measure and collected.

achievements.name: Locksmith
achievements.hint: A hundred locks, picked.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred locks picked.

achievements.name: Scroll-Reader
achievements.hint: A hundred scrolls, read.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred scrolls read aloud.

achievements.name: Wand-Waver
achievements.hint: A hundred wands, zapped.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred wands zapped.

achievements.name: Spellbound
achievements.hint: Twenty spells, learned.
achievements.unlocked_text: Twenty spells learned by heart.

achievements.name: Archmage
achievements.hint: Five hundred spells, cast.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five hundred spells cast.

achievements.name: Faithful
achievements.hint: Twenty-five prayers, answered.
achievements.unlocked_text: Twenty-five prayers answered.

achievements.name: Heard on High
achievements.hint: Ask for help from on high in your darkest hour.
achievements.unlocked_text: You called from the darkest hour, and you were answered.

achievements.name: A Full Purse
achievements.hint: Ten thousand gold, earned.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten thousand gold earned.

achievements.name: Merchant Prince
achievements.hint: A hundred thousand gold, earned.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred thousand gold. Merchants bow.

achievements.name: A King's Ransom
achievements.hint: A million gold, earned.
achievements.unlocked_text: A million gold: a king's ransom.

achievements.name: Known in Every Market
achievements.hint: Five traders, each paid at least once.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five traders know your face.

achievements.name: Solver of Mysteries
achievements.hint: Strange altars hide old stories. Solve one.
achievements.unlocked_text: A strange altar, solved.

achievements.name: Keeper of Mysteries
achievements.hint: Ten strange altars, solved.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten strange altars solved.

achievements.name: A Friend in the Dark
achievements.hint: Every Soul Sphere holds a friend.
achievements.unlocked_text: A friend, hatched from a Soul Sphere.

achievements.name: It's Evolving!
achievements.hint: Raise a companion until it changes.
achievements.unlocked_text: Your companion has changed.

achievements.name: Fully Grown
achievements.hint: Raise a companion to its final form.
achievements.unlocked_text: Your companion is fully grown.

achievements.name: Best Friend
achievements.hint: A companion at level 100.
achievements.unlocked_text: A companion at level 100. Best friends.

achievements.name: Four Elements
achievements.hint: Lightning, water, plant and fire, each at its final form.
achievements.unlocked_text: Lightning, water, plant and fire: all four grown.

achievements.name: He Always Comes
achievements.hint: A good dog always finds his way home.
achievements.unlocked_text: Shep found you. He always does.

achievements.name: Someone from Home
achievements.hint: Some spheres purr.
achievements.unlocked_text: A familiar face with whiskers, all the way down here.

achievements.name: Dad Is Here!
achievements.hint: Every kid knows who to call when things go wrong.
achievements.unlocked_text: Dad is here. Everything will be fine now.

achievements.name: I Choose You!
achievements.hint: In an old cartoon, a little fire lizard waited in the rain for a trainer who never came back.
achievements.unlocked_text: A small fire, left alone, chose you back.

achievements.name: Leaves Against the Rain
achievements.hint: In the old cartoon, a boy ran through a storm to keep the rain off a small fire.
achievements.unlocked_text: You laid a cloak of leaves over a small fire in the rain, and gave up a good cloak to do it.

achievements.name: Dance Partner
achievements.hint: In the old games, a small winged creature with a bobbing red pompom never turned down a dance.
achievements.unlocked_text: The last dancer of the old mines danced the dark back with you, and asked to come along.

achievements.name: Not a Step Missed
achievements.hint: Every step, on every beat.
achievements.unlocked_text: A dance-off danced without a single missed step. Even the bobble kept time.

achievements.name: First Past the Post
achievements.hint: In the old games, a golden bird could outrun anything on the track.
achievements.unlocked_text: You beat Gilt Varro's best bird on the Underway Run, and he stormed off without his winnings.

achievements.name: Free of the Tether
achievements.hint: In the old games, the golden birds would follow anyone who brought them the right greens.
achievements.unlocked_text: The young Bococho chose you. No rope, no fee, no Varro: just the two of you.

achievements.name: Slow and Steady
achievements.hint: The tortoise never hurried, and still he won.
achievements.unlocked_text: You won the Underway Run without a single sprint.

achievements.name: Riding Into the Deep
achievements.hint: A good bird carries her rider anywhere, even down.
achievements.unlocked_text: Down the stairs in the saddle. The Bococho did not even slow down.

achievements.name: Gentle Hands
achievements.hint: In the old tapestries, only the gentle could tame a unicorn.
achievements.unlocked_text: The unicorn trusts you.

achievements.name: Safe Passage
achievements.hint: Walk someone safely to where he or she is going.
achievements.unlocked_text: Someone is home safe, because of you.

achievements.name: Guardian of the Road
achievements.hint: Ten people, walked safely home.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten people walked safely home.

achievements.name: A Name of Power
achievements.hint: Some names open doors.
achievements.unlocked_text: You found a name that opens doors.

achievements.name: Five Names
achievements.hint: Five names of power.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five names of power, found.

achievements.name: Ten Names
achievements.hint: Ten names of power.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten names of power, found.

achievements.name: Twenty Names
achievements.hint: Twenty names of power.
achievements.unlocked_text: Twenty names of power. You know nearly every door.

achievements.name: Philosopher's Quest
achievements.hint: The Stone, carried home by a lover of wisdom from long ago.
achievements.unlocked_text: A philosopher brought the Stone home, as the title always promised.

achievements.name: Aim High
achievements.hint: Some names are above every hero.
achievements.unlocked_text: You aimed very high. Somebody corrected you.

achievements.name: A Word Kept
achievements.hint: Make a promise in the dungeon. Keep it.
achievements.unlocked_text: A promise kept.

achievements.name: Known for Your Word
achievements.hint: Ten promises kept.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten promises kept. People believe you now.

achievements.name: Oathkeeper
achievements.hint: Twenty-five promises kept.
achievements.unlocked_text: Twenty-five promises kept. Oathkeeper.

achievements.name: Clean Soul
achievements.hint: A soul as bright as a soul can shine.
achievements.unlocked_text: Your soul shines as brightly as a soul can.

achievements.name: Open Hands
achievements.hint: Five times, leave what you could have taken.
achievements.unlocked_text: Five times, you left what you could have taken.

achievements.name: Rescuer
achievements.hint: Ten people saved who could not save themselves.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten people saved.

achievements.name: Ten Journeys
achievements.hint: Ten journeys begun.
achievements.unlocked_text: Ten journeys begun.

achievements.name: Fifty Journeys
achievements.hint: Fifty journeys begun.
achievements.unlocked_text: Fifty journeys begun.

achievements.name: A Hundred Journeys
achievements.hint: A hundred journeys begun.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hundred journeys. The road knows your name.

achievements.name: Top Marks
achievements.hint: The highest grade there is.
achievements.unlocked_text: The highest grade there is.

achievements.name: An Adorable Duckie
achievements.hint: Munchkin players know the rule about ducks in dungeons.
achievements.unlocked_text: You picked up a duck in a dungeon. You should have known better.

achievements.name: The Duck of Doom
achievements.hint: Some say the Duck of Doom is only a hat. Some say it is only the beginning.
achievements.unlocked_text: It rode on your head for 10,000 turns, and then it hatched.

achievements.name: Sometimes Goose
achievements.hint: Even a duck can grow wings fit for heaven.
achievements.unlocked_text: A duck, grown into something holy.

achievements.name: Hack Reality
achievements.hint: In a colossal cave, long ago, adventurers learned a magic word.
achievements.unlocked_text: You spoke the First Word, and reality listened.

achievements.name: Segfault
achievements.hint: Even reality crashes sometimes.
achievements.unlocked_text: Reality rejected your invocation.

achievements.name: Convergence
achievements.hint: Three layers down, reality starts to listen.
achievements.unlocked_text: Three layers of reality, rewritten.

achievements.name: Singularity
achievements.hint: Past the last layer of reality, a wolf lies chained.
achievements.unlocked_text: Singularity. The wolf at the end of the world now follows you.

achievements.name: There Is No Cow Level
achievements.hint: The oldest rumour in dungeon-crawling. Surely it isn't true.
achievements.unlocked_text: There is no cow level. You have been there.

achievements.name: The Cow King
achievements.hint: Every farm has a king, even a farm that does not exist.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Cow King is defeated.

achievements.name: 'Tis but a Scratch
achievements.hint: None shall pass. Or so he says.
achievements.unlocked_text: You took his arm. He says it's just a flesh wound.

achievements.name: We'll Call It a Draw
achievements.hint: He is invincible. Just ask him.
achievements.unlocked_text: All right, you called it a draw.

achievements.name: The Game of Senet
achievements.hint: In an Egyptian tale, a prince played a ghost for a magic book.
achievements.unlocked_text: You won the Book of Thoth at senet.

achievements.name: Borrowed and Returned
achievements.hint: In the old tale, the prince who took the book learned to give it back.
achievements.unlocked_text: You gave the Book of Thoth back, and on time.

achievements.name: Because She Asked
achievements.hint: Ahwere lost everything to that book. Listen to her.
achievements.unlocked_text: You left the book where it lay, because she asked.

achievements.name: The Right Words
achievements.hint: Ash never could remember the last word.
achievements.unlocked_text: Klaatu, Barada, Nikto. Every word, exactly right.

achievements.name: Close Enough
achievements.hint: He said the words. Mostly.
achievements.unlocked_text: Hey, you said the words! The dead disagreed.

achievements.name: The Sword Reforged
achievements.hint: Odin broke the sword of Sigmund. Sigmund's son had it made whole.
achievements.unlocked_text: Gram is whole again.

achievements.name: The Thickest Shoe
achievements.hint: At Ragnarok, the silent god steps on the wolf's jaw. He will need a good shoe.
achievements.unlocked_text: Vidar's Sandal, made from every scrap.

achievements.name: The Ribbon That Holds a Wolf
achievements.hint: The dwarves bound Fenrir with things that do not exist.
achievements.unlocked_text: Gleipnir, made of six things that do not exist.

achievements.name: Short Handle
achievements.hint: A fly once bit a dwarf at the forge, and the hammer came out short.
achievements.unlocked_text: Mjolnir, short handle and all.

achievements.name: Tablet of Second Death
achievements.hint: The book of Revelation speaks of a second death.
achievements.unlocked_text: The Tablet of Second Death is whole.

achievements.name: A Shimmer in the Dark
achievements.hint: Something in the dungeon shimmers that does not belong to it.
achievements.unlocked_text: You found the Abyssal Shimmer.

achievements.name: Haunted by Myself
achievements.hint: In the oldest dungeon games, the dead leave ghosts for whoever comes next.
achievements.unlocked_text: You met the ghost of a hero you once were.

achievements.name: Burglar
achievements.hint: In the old poem, the dragon woke for a single cup.
achievements.unlocked_text: A whole hoard taken, and not one of its keepers stirred.

achievements.name: Stage Fright
achievements.hint: Some bands are worth staying for.
achievements.unlocked_text: You out-danced a whole band of the undead, round by round, and won.

achievements.name: Encore!
achievements.hint: A true fan always asks for one more song.
achievements.unlocked_text: You read eight names aloud, and the band came back to play one more song.

achievements.name: Behind the Curtain
achievements.unlocked_text: Pay no attention to the person behind the curtain.

achievements.name: Not Dead Yet
achievements.unlocked_text: Your hero was not dead yet. Not quite.

achievements.name: Rip Van Winkle
achievements.hint: He slept for twenty years under the mountain and woke to a world that had moved on.
achievements.unlocked_text: Your hero went to sleep in one age of the world and woke up in the next, as if nothing had happened.

achievements.name: Thirty Lives
achievements.hint: Up, up, down, down...
achievements.unlocked_text: Up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right, B, A. Old games remember.

achievements.name: Nice Try
achievements.hint: There is only one Dad.
achievements.unlocked_text: Nice try.

achievements.name: A Hollow Voice
achievements.hint: Some hints are written in Caesar's hand.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hollow voice says, "Plugh."

achievements.name: Caviar and Tater Tots
achievements.hint: A Man Before a King once sang of a supper nobody saw coming.
achievements.unlocked_text: High and low on different plates, sitting at the same table tonight. Nobody saw this coming, but somehow everything's right.

achievements.name: So Then I Was Like...
achievements.hint: A Man Before a King told his daughter math was cool. She did not believe him.
achievements.unlocked_text: Newton and Leibniz, Galois writing till dawn, Wiles in his attic. Math isn't numbers, it's blood, sweat and tears. Math is cool.

achievements.name: Neither Would Give Way
achievements.hint: In the old ballad, two strangers with quarterstaffs met in the middle of a narrow bridge.
achievements.unlocked_text: You knocked Robin Hood off the bridge into the stream, as Little John once did, and he gave you his horn.

achievements.name: Not Yet the Hour
achievements.hint: By the Roman Wall they tell of a farmer who followed his ball of thread under the hill, and found a king asleep.
achievements.unlocked_text: You drew the sword, cut the garter and blew the bugle-horn, and the king under the hill woke for you.

achievements.name: One Who Listens
achievements.hint: In the Eddas, the watchman of the gods needs less sleep than a bird and can hear the grass grow.
achievements.unlocked_text: You sat the watch with Heimdall at the foot of the bridge, and heard what he heard. He put Gjallarhorn in your hands.

achievements.name: Not by Strength
achievements.hint: In Malory, a knight heard a great enchanter groaning under a stone that a hundred men could not lift.
achievements.unlocked_text: You answered Merlin's questions at the great stone, and he gave you his staff out of the hawthorn.
